submission_format: A single Python module named solution.py

evaluation.pass_rule: All correctness tests pass and the weighted score is at least 0.7

title: Train a Neural Network
summary: Implement forward and backward propagation for a two-layer network and solve XOR.
requirements: init_params(n_in, n_hidden, n_out, seed) returns W1 (n_in, n_hidden), b1 (n_hidden,), W2 (n_hidden, n_out), b2 (n_out,)
forward(params, X) uses tanh in the hidden layer and sigmoid at the output; returns (probs, cache)
backward(params, cache, y) returns gradients of the mean binary cross-entropy with the same keys as params
train(X, y, n_hidden, lr, epochs, seed) returns trained params; with n_hidden=8 it must classify XOR perfectly for at least 2 of 3 seeds
description: Use the row convention `Z = X @ W + b`. Your backward pass is gradient-checked against finite differences, then trained on XOR.
